description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android application. It manages displaying detailed information about a selected content item, including fetching additional details from a remote API, loading images, and handling user interactions such as initiating playback through a network call. It also includes comprehensive documentation and comments describing the class's interface and behavior.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: Activity class that displays content details, fetches additional info from server, and manages user interactions to initiate media playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, loads poster image, retrieves intent extras, and starts fetching content info from server.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content details from remote API endpoint and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles the playback initiation process: making network request to get media URL, then launching player activity.
